$comment: 3.2-profile counterpart of negative/005-alg-not-allowed.json. AdCP 3.2 profile: the signature covers content-digest, binary values use RFC 8941 sf-binary (standard padded Base64), and the verifier advertises covers_content_digest='required'. Signature is the 64-zero-byte placeholder (step-ordering canary): the targeted check runs before cryptographic verification, so a verifier that verifies first returns request_signature_invalid instead of the expected code.
